entity.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) - Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)

lineage.description: IOM DTM conducted village-level assessments across South Sudan from May 2016 to November 2019, collecting data on IDP and returnee populations disaggregated by gender and age. The assessment integrated multi-sectoral needs evaluation to identify vulnerable populations, producing a structured dataset of displacement impacts at the village administrative level.
